name: OnyxDAO
fix_description: In liquidateWithSingleRepayFresh(), validate that oTokenRepay and oTokenCollateral are registered markets in the Comptroller before proceeding. Without this check, an attacker can pass a fake market contract that returns manipulated values for borrowBalanceCurrent and liquidateBorrow, enabling unauthorized extraction of funds.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC chains a flash loan, market entry, exchange-rate/collateral manipulation on oETH, multiple borrows across markets, and a highly protocol-specific fake oToken liquidation path abusing NFTLiquidationProxy with several custom contracts. Exploiting it requires deep understanding of Onyx/Compound-style accounting and non-obvious state interactions, well beyond a straightforward single-pattern bug.
